response.rationale: Both answers and the English sense are correct, but the card omits a material shared-synonym contrast: Indonesian also uses “majikan.” Presenting the pair as simply different common words may lead learners to infer that “majikan” is not Indonesian. Malaysian “majikan” is directly supported as employer; Indonesian “pemberi kerja” is the broad, neutral term, while “majikan” is also valid and can carry boss/household-employer nuances.
